source_text.GH#2533: REQ-497 PR 1b matrix-trust-boundary + latest-commit security gate

task.description: SECURITY-REVIEWER gate: authorization.ex policy keys, permission_matrix --check result, record_guard_refused resource_type change. Read-only.

result.summary: PASS. In scope (authorization.ex, migration, tenant-data routes). (1) authorization.ex: 4 new endpoint_policy_key clauses (ScopeEnforcementRead/Manage, ScopeGrantsIntegrityRead, ScopeEnforcementTokensRead) all map via required_permission to existing :UsersGroupsRolesManage (TENANT_ADMIN, PLATFORM_ADMIN in platform tenant only); no new permission atom, no role grant widened; golden file lists role x permission rows and has no per-policy-key rows, so it is unchanged by design. Router additionally requires Scope.require_tenant_wide (403 otherwise), tenant from auth_context only. No change under .github, mix.exs, config, lib/mix, permission_matrix.ex, modules/catalog.ex, priv/permission_matrix (diff stat confirms). ORCH-reported `MIX_ENV=dev mix letflow.permission_matrix --check`: result=pass, golden unchanged, core matrix changes: none (not rerun by reviewer). (2) Latest commit daa6ff02a: Identity.record_guard_refused/2 gains optional :resource_type (default user); after_state still exactly {action, actor, target_id, reason_code, counted_admins, trace_id}; raises if inside a transaction, so own transaction after rollback; on audit failure logs kind only (no value) and returns :ok while the refusal stands (fail-closed, INV-8 ok). TenantAdminGuard.write_refusal(...,nil) delegates to it with resource_type(action); platform-companion path keeps commit_entries writer. No secrets/hashes in audit: token.listed stores ids and count only; TokenView omits token_hash; shadow log emits hashed caller/tenant ids and route patterns only. INV-1: migration adds public tenants.scope_enforcement with CHECK off|shadow, default off, not in tenant-scoped migrations; flag cast only by scope_enforcement_changeset, prefix from scoped_opts. INV-4 ok. INV-2/3/5 N/A. INV-6/7/8 no violations found. Minor non-blocking note: two audit writers now coexist for the platform-companion path.
